vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: guardrail-smart-accounts
Version: 1.1.1

The skill bundle provides documentation and configuration for 'AgentGuardrail,' a service designed to manage ERC-4337 smart accounts with on-chain spending limits for AI agents. The SKILL.md file contains comprehensive instructions, contract addresses for Base and Sepolia, and API usage examples for the domain https://agentguardrail.xyz. It explicitly includes security warnings against sharing private keys or seed phrases and follows a least-privilege model for transaction signing. No malicious code, data exfiltration logic, or harmful prompt injections were identified.

llm.summary: This skill appears purpose-built for smart-account guardrails, but users should review it because it handles financial authority and sends dashboard credentials plus planned transaction details to a configurable API service.

dimensions.detail: Required RPC and signing configuration is proportionate, but API examples attach GUARDRAIL_DASHBOARD_API_KEY to GUARDRAIL_API_URL and send transaction-intent fields; the URL is configurable and the privacy section understates off-chain validation/audit data.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The inspected artifact contains only a Markdown skill file; no bundled executable scripts, dependencies, installer, hooks, or background service were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill gives explicit safety limits such as not asking for private keys, using read-only mode without signing, and avoiding unrelated local files or environment variables, but it also documents high-impact policy and permission mutations.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No host-level persistence is instructed, but the skill intentionally creates persistent on-chain accounts, policies, permissions, and audit records as part of its financial control model.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose and main capabilities are coherent: deploy and manage ERC-4337 smart accounts, policies, permissions, validation, and audit for on-chain spending limits.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you trust AgentGuardrail or your self-hosted API endpoint with dashboard credentials and pre-transaction intent data. Use scoped, revocable API keys and signer tokens, start on testnet, prefer explicit allowlists and low spending limits, and avoid setting GUARDRAIL_API_URL to any endpoint you do not control or trust.
llm.findings: [T09] expected: The artifact confirms the API validation and management examples send bearer authentication and action details to the configured API endpoint. That API use is purpose-aligned, but the configurable destination and inconsistent privacy disclosure make it a review concern rather than evidence of malicious behavior.
